content:
Fourteen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

MILERA, MIGUEL ANGEL

MILERA, MIGUEL ANGEL was arrested on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 11:50 p.m. by Laredo Police Department on an alleged charge of assault against an elderly or disabled individual, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

FLORES-CARDOZA, VICENTE ANTONIO

FLORES-CARDOZA, VICENTE ANTONIO was arrested on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 6:48 a.m. by the Department of Public Safety on an alleged charge of driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

MORA, KARLA YVETTE

MORA, KARLA YVETTE was arrested on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 6:46 a.m. by the Department of Public Safety on an alleged charge of driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

ALVAREZ, DESIREE LYNETTE

ALVAREZ, DESIREE LYNETTE was arrested on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 6:51 a.m. by the Department of Public Safety on an alleged charge of interference with public duties, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

ROJAS-TORRES, GRISCELA

ROJAS-TORRES, GRISCELA was booked on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 10:45 a.m. on an alleged federal violation. Bond had not been set at the time of booking. She is being held by Customs and Border Protection on an immigration hold.

ESPINOZA-GONZALEZ, NORMA

ESPINOZA-GONZALEZ, NORMA was arrested on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 12:50 p.m. by the Webb County Sheriff's Office on alleged charges of evading arrest or detention, a Class B misdemeanor, and interference with public duties, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $4,000 on one charge and $8,000 on the other. She is also being held on an immigration hold.

BENAVIDES, ARMANDO GERARDO

BENAVIDES, ARMANDO GERARDO was arrested on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 3:44 p.m. by the Webb County Sheriff's Office on an alleged charge of accident involving damage to a vehicle of $200 or more, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

LOZANO, JESUS ANGEL

LOZANO, JESUS ANGEL was arrested on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 3:44 p.m. by Laredo Police Department on an alleged charge of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

CRUTCHFIELD, NATHAN

CRUTCHFIELD, NATHAN was arrested on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 5:58 p.m. by Laredo Police Department on an alleged charge of assault causing bodily injury, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

MUNIZ, MEGAN NICHOLE

MUNIZ, MEGAN NICHOLE was arrested on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 7:00 p.m. by Laredo Police Department on an alleged charge of theft of property valued at $750 to less than $2,500, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $1,000.

SANCHEZ, JEROME

SANCHEZ, JEROME was arrested on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 8:08 p.m. by Laredo Police Department on alleged charges of criminal mischief valued at $100 to less than $750, a Class B misdemeanor, and assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

BUCKLER, CHRISTINA

BUCKLER, CHRISTINA was arrested on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 8:44 p.m. by Laredo Police Department on an alleged charge of accident involving damage to a vehicle of $200 or more, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $500.

BARRIENTOS, JOSE ORLANDO, JR

BARRIENTOS, JOSE ORLANDO, JR was arrested on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 9:29 p.m. by Laredo Police Department on two alleged counts of organized retail theft valued at $100 to less than $750, Class A misdemeanors. Bond was set at $5,000 on each count.

GONZALEZ-TREJO, CRISTHIAN EDUARDO

GONZALEZ-TREJO, CRISTHIAN EDUARDO was booked on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 10:30 p.m. on an alleged federal violation. Bond had not been set at the time of booking. He is being held by the United States Marshals.
